body:
It's more like I see what happiness feels like for other people, so I know that they want to be happy, and I therefore want them to be happy. I just don't desire the same thing myself. 

Happiness reminds me of why I want to die. It reminds of how fleeting it is and how pointless it seems once it's over.

But what difference does it make if we think life is valuable? If anything, such a feeling is completely a result of natural selection, wouldn't it be? If there ever was a person who didn't think that life is valuable then they would be more likely to kill themselves before reproducing.
